semiconductor_relevance: Medium — while primarily focused on analytical services, the company serves the semiconductor industry among others.
summary: Sumika Chemical Analysis Service, Ltd. (SCAS) provides analytical services that cater to various industries, including semiconductor and electronics. With over 50 years of expertise, SCAS offers versatile analysis solutions that support the needs of its clients in the semiconductor value chain.

regional_presence.Taiwan: SCAS has established a presence in Taiwan to provide analytical services tailored to the semiconductor industry.
regional_presence.Singapore: SCAS set up its first overseas laboratory in Singapore in 1997 to expand its analytical capabilities.
regional_presence.Belgium: An organically linked laboratory was established in Belgium in 2007 to further enhance its analytical business sphere.
